arxiv-1907-07367.title: Query complexity of generalized Simon’s problem
arxiv-1907-07367.creator: Zekun Ye, Yunqi Huang, Lvzhou Li, Yuyi Wang
arxiv-1907-07367.description: Abstract Simon’s problem plays an important role in the history of quantum algorithms, as it inspired Shor to discover the celebrated quantum algorithm solving integer factorization in polynomial time. Besides, the quantum algorithm for Simon’s problem has been recently applied to break symmetric cryptosystems.

arxiv-2108-10358.title: On Adaptive Transmission for Distributed Detection in Energy Harvesting Wireless Sensor Networks with Limited Fusion Center Feedback Parts of this work were presented in GlobalSIP 2018 [ 1 ] and GLOBECOM 2019 [ 2 ] .
arxiv-2108-10358.creator: Ghazaleh Ardeshiri, Azadeh Vosoughi
arxiv-2108-10358.description: Abstract We consider a wireless sensor network, consisting of N N heterogeneous sensors and a fusion center (FC), tasked with solving a binary distributed detection problem. Sensors communicate directly with the FC over orthogonal fading channels. Each sensor can harvest randomly arriving energy and store it in a battery.

arxiv-2108-13449.title: Population Protocols: Beyond Runtime Analysis Thanks: The work surveyed in this note was supported by the European Research Council (ERC) under the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation program under grant agreement No 787367 “Parameterized Verification and Synthesis” (PaVeS).
arxiv-2108-13449.creator: Javier Esparza
arxiv-2108-13449.description: Abstract We survey our recent work on the verification of population protocols and their state complexity. 1 Introduction Population protocols are a model of computation in which an arbitrary number of indistinguishable finite-state agents interact in pairs to collectively decide if their initial global configuration satisfies a given property. Population protocols were introduced by Angluin et al.

arxiv-2110-01261.title: Scaling Graph-based Deep Learning models to larger networks
arxiv-2110-01261.creator: Miquel Ferriol-Galmés 1 , José Suárez-Varela 1 , Krzysztof Rusek 1,2 , Pere Barlet-Ros 1 , Albert Cabellos-Aparicio 1
arxiv-2110-01261.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Miquel Ferriol-Galmés 1 , José Suárez-Varela 1 , Krzysztof Rusek 1,2 , Pere Barlet-Ros 1 , Albert Cabellos-Aparicio 1. Graph Neural Networks (GNN) have shown a strong potential to be integrated into commercial products for network control and management. Early works using GNN have demonstrated an unprecedented capability to learn from different network characteristics that are fundamentally represented as graphs, such as the topology, the routing configuration, or the traffic that flows along a series of nodes in the network.

arxiv-2111-02203.title: Anomalous excitations of atomically crafted quantum magnets
arxiv-2111-02203.creator: Sascha Brinker 1,∗ , Felix Küster 2 , Stuart S. P. Parkin 2 , Paolo Sessi 2 , Samir Lounis 1,3,∗
arxiv-2111-02203.description: Abstract High energy resolution spectroscopic studies of quantum magnets proved extremely valuable in accessing magnetodynamics quantities, such as energy barriers, magnetic interactions and lifetime of excited states. Here, we explore the evolution of a new flavor of low-energy spin-excitations for quantum spins coupled to an electron bath.

arxiv-2306-10934.title: Is the diagonal case a general picture for Loop Quantum Cosmology?
arxiv-2306-10934.creator: Matteo Bruno, Giovanni Montani
arxiv-2306-10934.description: Abstract The correct implementation of the Loop Quantum Gravity to the early homogeneous Universe has been the subject of a long debate in the literature because the S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) symmetry cannot be properly retained. The role of this symmetry is expressed by the Gauss constraint. Here, a non-vanishing Gauss constraint is found.

arxiv-2308-10745.title: A novel method for calculating Bose-Einstein correlation functions with Coulomb final-state interaction Dedicated to T. Csörgő on the occasion of his 60th birthday.
arxiv-2308-10745.creator: Márton Nagy, Aletta Purzsa, Máté Csanád, Dániel Kincses
arxiv-2308-10745.description: Abstract Measurements of Bose-Einstein correlations played a crucial role in the discovery and the subsequent detailed exploration of the Quark-Gluon-Plasma (QGP) created in high-energy collisions of heavy nuclei. Such measurements gave rise to femtoscopy, a flourishing sub-field of high-energy physics, and there are important new directions to explore and discoveries to be made in the near future.

arxiv-2312-08781.title: The von Bahr-Esseen type inequality under sub-linear expectations and applications Thanks: Supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (12201079), the Natural Science Foundation of Anhui Province (2108085MA06, 2108085QA15), and the Excellent Scientific Research and Innovation Team
arxiv-2312-08781.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by . Moment inequalities play important roles in probability limit theory and mathematical statistics. In this work, the von Bahr-Esseen type inequality for extended negatively dependent random variables under sub-linear expectations is established successfully. By virtue of the inequality, we further obtain the Kolmogorov type weak law of large numbers for partial sums and the complete convergence for weighted sums, which extend and improve corresponding results in sub-linear expectation space.

arxiv-2404-08318.title: Non-Gaussianity from primordial black holes Preprint: APCTP-Pre2024-008
arxiv-2404-08318.creator: Jinn-Ouk Gong 1,2, Naoya Kitajima 3,4
arxiv-2404-08318.description: Abstract We study the effects of non-Gaussianity from primordial black holes (PBHs). The formation of PBHs is in general a rare event and the number of PBHs fluctuates following the Poisson distribution function, which is independent from the pre-existing inflationary adiabatic fluctuations. Such fluctuations can dominate over the adiabatic mode on small scales.

arxiv-2506-17832.title: Leveling the Playing Field: Carefully Comparing Classical and Learned Controllers for Quadrotor Trajectory Tracking
arxiv-2506-17832.creator: Pratik Kunapuli, Jake Welde, Dinesh Jayaraman, Vijay Kumar
arxiv-2506-17832.description: Abstract Learning-based control approaches like reinforcement learning (RL) have recently produced a slew of impressive results for tasks like quadrotor trajectory tracking and drone racing. Naturally, it is common to demonstrate the advantages of these new controllers against established methods like analytical controllers.

arxiv-2601-09916.title: Learning-Augmented Perfectly Secure Collaborative Matrix Multiplication
arxiv-2601-09916.creator: Zixuan He 1 , M. Reza Deylam Salehi, Derya Malak 1 , Photios A. Stavrou 1
arxiv-2601-09916.description: Abstract This paper presents a perfectly secure matrix multiplication (PSMM) protocol for multiparty computation (MPC) of A ⊤ ​ B \mathrm{A}^{\top}\mathrm{B} over finite fields. The proposed scheme guarantees correctness and information-theoretic privacy against threshold-bounded, semi-honest colluding agents, under explicit local storage constraints.

pmc-12441830.creator: Lidia Sánchez-Morales, Néstor Porras, Andrea Pérez-Domingo, Marta Pérez-Sancho, Teresa García-Seco, Marta Diaz-Frutos, Aranzazu Buendia, Inmaculada Moreno, Leydis Zamora, Ana Balseiro, M. However, studies reported quite different results on its effect against COVID-19.

pmc-12519999.title: Inflamed Skin, Burdened Heart: A Multidisciplinary Perspective on Atopic Dermatitis and Cardiovascular Health
pmc-12519999.creator: Chenghui Ma, Yikang Xu, Wenshuo Bai, Yulin Zou
pmc-12519999.description: The diseases of both skin and cardiovascular are the most significant global medical challenges for their high rates of morbidity and mortality. Although not life-threatening, skin diseases significantly impair patients’ quality of life and affect a large proportion of the population due to their chronic and persistent nature.

pmc-12597838.title: Native Mitral Valve Endocarditis Complicated by Intermittent Heart Block With Spontaneous Recovery: A Case Report
pmc-12597838.creator: Rayan Abou Zeid, Assaad Maalouf, Rachad Salame, Elie Stephan
pmc-12597838.description: Isolated native mitral valve endocarditis without aortic involvement is a rare but serious cause of complete heart block. In contrast, aortic valve endocarditis is a well-recognized cause of life-threatening conduction abnormalities due to its close anatomical relationship with the conduction system.

pmc-13560918.title: Upper respiratory tract CD8+ tissue-resident memory T cells protect against viral transmission
pmc-13560918.creator: Sarah E. Michalets, Yixel Soto-Vazquez, Kathryn M. Moore, M. Elliott Williams, Ananya Saha, Ariana Jimenez, Yu-shan Huang, Anice C. Lowen, Christopher D. Scharer, Alison Swaims-Kohlmeier, Rustom Antia, Jacob E. Kohlmeier
pmc-13560918.description: Michalets et al. demonstrate that upper respiratory tract tissue-resident memory CD8+ T cells are sufficient to protect against respiratory virus transmission, even in the absence of CD4 T cells, B cells, or lower respiratory tract immune responses, establishing a critical role for nasal CD8+ T cell surveillance in limiting respiratory virus spread.
